title: [master][Gen. Jnl.-Post Line]` Add var NextEntryNo, var NextVATEntryNo, and var NextTransactionNo to OnAfterInitGLRegister in StartPosting
summary: The OnAfterInitGLRegister event raised from StartPosting in codeunit Gen. Jnl.-Post Line now passes NextEntryNo, NextVATEntryNo and NextTransactionNo as var parameters, so subscribers can read and change them.
key_points: OnAfterInitGLRegister in StartPosting gains var NextEntryNo, NextVATEntryNo and NextTransactionNo
Applied to Gen. Jnl.-Post Line in W1 and all localized layers
Existing subscribers keep working; new subscribers can use the extra parameters
